item.title: Seneca man dies after slipping on ice following storm
item.description: SENECA, S.C. (WSPA) - The Oconee County Coroner's Office said a man died Wednesday evening after slipping on an ice patch outside of his home. A 79-year-old man slipped on ice from the recent winter storm while walking down his driveway to his mailbox Wednesday afternoon, the coroner's office said. He was found unresponsive by [...]

item.title: Dozens more measles cases reported in Upstate outbreak, hundreds still in quarantine
item.description: State health officials reported 58 new measles cases in the Upstate Friday. This brings the total number of cases related to the current outbreak to 847.

item.title: Teens charged months after deadly shooting at Spartanburg Co. apartments
item.description: Two suspects have been charged in connection to a shooting that killed a 16-year-old at an apartment complex in Spartanburg County.

item.title: 'A pretty hectic week': Spartanburg Co. crews prepare for second winter storm
item.description: Spartanburg County emergency crews are once again preparing for winter weather, marking the second system to impact the area in less than two weeks.
